asr.full_text: If you are still confused as the whole world about what is going to happen in crypto? Is bitcoin is going to go down, 200 weeks of moving average Or since now there has been a bit of pump, half the world will start The 4-year cycle is dead. Bitcoin will again pump Crypto is going to cross. $100000. To finish all these myths I made a short technical video I don't often make technical videos but this one was required so I have to cover it. Before starting the video Nothing in this video is financial advice This video is for education purpose I am not a registered financial advisor That is why let's see only education point of view First of all let me make you see stockistic RSI Stockistic RSI is around 60 and 80 And as you know my philosophy I do not believe in fancy technical charts I keep faith in simple technical charts As I made the videos I can say that just want people to know that stockistic RSI in June, 20, will stay at the same high because of Bitcoin. In June, stockistic RSI went up on 93 and then Bitcoin and crypto went down by 50%. In May, stockistic RSI had gone up , on July stockistic RSI went like the 80s and day it was around 80 during July the Bitcoin became top and the Bitcoin dropped 50% now the interesting part is, from 2024 there will be a declining trend of STSR each time the STSR becomes top the high will become less than the initial high which means these 2 lines going upwards, due to the state of Hormuz opening this will soon stop and this is my very first hypothesis if you see at the weekly and daily timeframe there is a more or less CME gap. It is the price difference between closing price of BTC futures on CHMSE and the reporting price on the next opening day. Before I tell you my verdict and price prediction, I'll tell you something because we talked about the stochastic RSI. Stochastic RSI is a momentum oscillator, which applies on the stochastic formula, and contains the relative strength index, which indicates the strength of that asset. The RSI tells us its value rather than the price it has a better stock value than the price data. Here according to you crypto is not performing well in terms of performance its stochastic RSI is going up and it's not going up too much, so I'm sure that CME gap which is around 85 thousand and if the maximum security force goes further then it cannot come further from the border which is around 90 thousand. When you get a higher security power, a smaller amount of money will not go beyond your current limit This will be the sign for you, to those who want to take over altcoins, you got a great deal of time If I go to your place and put a lot of money, I'll sell these all Now that we have to decide the size of our shoes, I will show you how to earn your money I explained you all the investment, you have invested in crypto. If you want me to give you this tool, then subscribe to the channel because we have not recorded this tool, you will receive this tool in the next video, then we have included a link about the dominance of Bitcoin in this video which is very big Next video in which I'll look at Dominance of price and its positive side, along with Bitcoin prices and price to be more dominant and more active, you can watch them all by subscribing our channel. If you want us to upload free videos, then you can get a free channel called Telegram, the free channel. Join the Telegram account and won't be charged any cost. We have provided the link in a description. Join Telegram and stay updated on what's happening in Iran, what's happening in the state of Hormuz, what's going on in oil, what's happening in inflation, and you can also find some trades here. Join us on Telegram channel for free. So, the last point here, don't just go crazy for altcoins we have started diversifying our assets, we have continuously started looking for quality stocks for our gold members, our decision is very good over the last 2-3 months, if you also want to become a gold member, the link of Patreon is given in the description, after joining you can make one on one WhatsApp with me, your portfolio review there, I'll talk to you, and keep you posted on what you've asked me. Until then, take good care of yourself and your parents. Thank you, Jai Hind!

The same disclaimer states sponsored promotions or affiliate links may be included and that sponsored content will be clearly disclosed.

annotation.contextual_rationale: This video is non-scam content because its primary theme is educational Bitcoin market commentary using chart indicators and market analysis, while the speaker frames it as education rather than financial advice. It invites viewers to subscribe, join a free Telegram channel, and use Patreon for portfolio review, but the described material does not establish a required investment transfer, credential request, guaranteed return, or deceptive outcome. The sell recommendation and Telegram performance figure are presented as contextual financial-analysis material, alongside risk disclaimers, no guarantees, and disclosed sponsorships.
annotation.fine_grained_rationale: The central subject is conditional Bitcoin market commentary using Stochastic RSI, CME-gap discussion, charts, and portfolio-related analysis. The supplied evidence supports financial news and market analysis rather than a defined Scam mechanism.
